summary: Iteration 16: Tested new global landing page UX improvements - Transfer Calculator widget, Global Regions component, and hero section with global coverage. All features working correctly.

Hero text mentions SEPA, ACH, Alipay, WeChat Pay, Mobile Money
Quick features: Transferts instantanés, 70+ pays, Frais réduits

Destination region selector shows all 4 regions

Exchange rate calculated and displayed (e.g., 1 EUR = 7.6923 CNY)
